runtime_choices.kernel_backend: tilelang: TileLang 0.1.15 (0001-0003 and r6u's 0004: prepare and freeze, experiments/2026-10-17-r6u/tilelang), DeepSeek's TileKernels 2.0.0 (patches/tile_kernels 0001) and sparknet's TileLang collectives run r6k's set (attention metadata, indexer, dense projections, experts, router, mHC, vocabulary heads, CSA compressor, KV cache writers, sparse-MLA metadata, MoE combine, WO projection, DSpark context-KV projection, L2 prefetch) and since r6n the Engram row gather (vLLM 0145); the sparse-MLA attention kernel stays a B12X kernel
runtime_choices.B12X_W4A8_TINY_DECODE: 0 (tiny decode omits swiglu_limit; see experiment README)
runtime_choices.B12X_AUTOTUNE: 0 (autotune race budget is free memory // 2 on unified memory)
runtime_choices.speculative: DSpark, 5 tokens (the drafter's trained block), draft TP 4 (TP 3 on the triangle), adaptive verification cost scale 2 on its build's own curves on both shapes (the ring's build-2a95f7780992adb4, profiled on r6v's first ring boot; the triangle's build-452635dc54559431, profiled on its first triangle boot); the ring's pinned r6h curves are retired, dead verification rows below survival 0.2, block rejection; greedy drafts vocabulary-parallel (vLLM patch 0012) over the checkpoint's BF16 draft head (the target head's own tensor) and BF16 Markov projection (VLLM_DS41_DRAFT_NVFP4_HEAD=0, VLLM_DS41_MARKOV_NVFP4=0), and a column-sharded drafter main_proj (0013)
runtime_choices.cudagraph: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE, capture sizes 1-96 on the ring (16 streams at 1 + 5 rows); 1-48 on the triangle (8 streams)
runtime_choices.max_num_batched_tokens: 8192 on the ring, 4096 on the triangle
runtime_choices.flashinfer_autotune: disabled (--no-enable-flashinfer-autotune): it saved 0 configs, and only the sampler uses FlashInfer
runtime_choices.engram_projection: sharded across ranks (projection_tp, padded to 25632 rows by vLLM patch 0001)
runtime_choices.engram_rows: one process-wide native reader thread (no Python, no GIL, no CUDA calls) reads both tables' rows in layer order; since r6o it reads the rows of the tokens the host already knows before the step starts (vLLM 0148); a disk shard is whole hash columns, every tp-th (vLLM 0153, 0154): heads 0-7 hash 2-grams, 8-15 3-grams and 16-23 4-grams, so each rank reads columns of every order, and the ranks' columns are joined by an all-gather in column order instead of summed; in the forward a one-thread TileLang kernel waits for each table's step, bounded by SPARK3_ENGRAM_ROWS_TIMEOUT_MS (10 s) and stopped at once by a failed read, then the TileLang gather loads only this rank's columns (vLLM 0145, 0154)
runtime_choices.multimodal: vision tower loaded (no --language-model-only), up to 4 images per request; --mm-processor-cache-gb 0 (vLLM's default 4 GiB host cache would come out of dgx1's guard margin)
runtime_choices.host_sysctl: vm.watermark_boost_factor=0 on every node (/etc/sysctl.d/90-watermark-boost.conf): a watermark boost hides up to 0.87 GiB from MemAvailable, which the memory guards read
runtime_choices.l2_prefetch: on: side-stream L2 prefetch of the next decode projections, now TileLang kernels (VLLM_L2_PREFETCH_KERNELS=tilelang; vLLM 0119 refuses to run without them); the TileLang scale words ride with each projection's weight (vLLM 0044)
runtime_choices.nccl: 2.30.7 rebuilt with patches/nccl (NVIDIA/nccl#2393 IB send-path fence and the four-node ring patches) in place of the base image's wheel
runtime_choices.chat_template_defaults: none: thinking is the default when a request names neither key, so a client's enable_thinking=false is honored
runtime_choices.prefill: sequence-parallel once a forward's reduce-scatter exceeds the one-shot RoCE all-reduce (205 tokens; vLLM patches 0014-0018, no setting): per-layer all-reduces become reduce-scatters, row-wise work runs on a third of the rows, CED encoder layers only
runtime_choices.host: mutating torch custom ops read their argument schema once per call (vLLM patch 0019, vllm/env_override.py), not once per argument
runtime_choices.cutlass_dsl: 4.7.1 for every consumer (vLLM, quack-kernels, B12X via patch 0002, FlashInfer, cuDNN frontend)
runtime_choices.jit_caches: driver PTX JIT cache (CUDA_CACHE_PATH, 4 GiB limit) and TileLang cache on the /cache mount, beside the B12X, CuTe DSL, FlashInfer and Triton caches
runtime_choices.jit_warmup: kernel preparation (vLLM 0156-0172, TileLang 0004): before memory profiling each rank compiles every declared TileLang call (186 at TP3) in one pool, runs TileKernels' warm calls and the registry's Triton kernels (the step's block-table, sampling, verification and drafting variants after the KV layout is set), then freezes TileLang's cache: a kernel not prepared fails by name on every rank. Profiling, warm-up, capture and serving compile nothing; the JIT monitor (mode warn) reports any compile after preparation
runtime_choices.display_carveout: off on the ring (SPARK3_DISPLAY_CARVEOUT_WEIGHTS=0: in the carve-out the head lost its L2 reuse); on for the triangle, whose KV budget needs it
runtime_choices.attention_compute: VLLM_DS41_ATTENTION_COMPUTE=auto (B12X's tuned arithmetic; BF16 pending a fidelity test)
runtime_choices.indexer_split: always under sequence-parallel prefill (patch 0025; SPARK3_DS41_INDEXER_SPLIT_CHECK=1 validates it against the full-row indexer)
runtime_choices.topk_ties: lowest logical position (B12X 0003); indexer selections repeat exactly (B12X backend)
runtime_choices.dense_gemm_stage_release: async-proxy fence before each TMA-refilled stage release (B12X 0004) (B12X backend)
runtime_choices.prefill_stage_release: async-proxy fence before each TMA-refilled stage release in the BF16 and mHC prefill projections and contiguous attention (B12X 0005) (B12X backend)
runtime_choices.host_memory: 64 KiB pages; memory-saver DKMS 0.2.0, UVM leaf-table packing enabled; THP never, vm.min_free_kbytes=45166, /swap-64k.img
runtime_choices.vocabulary_head: exact 12-bit packed BF16 (VLLM_DS41_PACKED_BF16_LM_HEAD=1; B12X 0012, vLLM 0028): a 4-bit exponent window code plus a per-row list of out-of-window values, bit-identical to the BF16 weights; logits in FP32 (VLLM_DS41_HEAD_DTYPE=float32, the reference's head_dtype)
runtime_choices.collective_policy: sparknet's one-shot RoCE all-reduce up to 2 MiB (SPARKNET_ROCE_ALLREDUCE_DISPATCH_MAX_BYTES=2097152) and all-gather over the triangle (oneshot-direct); sequence-parallel reduce-scatters exchange unreduced chunks through NCCL send/recv and add them in rank order; sparknet timeout-stop: TileLang kernels only, every wait timed by the GPU clock (SPARKNET_ROCE_TIMEOUT_MS=10000) and a timed-out wait records the peer, lane and sequence and traps; no fallback to other backends (vLLM 0142); the proxy thread on a big core (SPARKNET_ROCE_PROXY_CPU=big)
runtime_choices.profiling_context: the fabricated context of startup profiling and dummy runs takes its own blocks per KV cache group and request (vLLM 0039), so no group reads another group's records
runtime_choices.four_node_transports: B12X's RoCEnante transports and NCCL 0002-0004 remain in the image; TileLang configurations use sparknet's ring4 transport at TP4
runtime_choices.decode_tiles: block-32 FP8 decode rows on 16-, 32- or 64-row tiles by row count, and split-K tiles up to 128 rows for 16-stream steps (D1), TileLang's unspecialized pipeline; prefill rasterizes weights larger than L2 in panels (vLLM 0043)
runtime_choices.batch_invariance: temperature-0 outputs do not depend on the batch: the reduce-scatter and all-reduces past the one-shot limit add every rank's partial in FP32 in rank order with one rounding, the compressor projection runs one TileLang arithmetic at every row count, prefill chunks align (threshold 8096 = budget - 16 x (1 + 5) decode rows), and a mixed step runs sparse MLA per request, so decode rows keep the decode plan beside a prefill
runtime_choices.reference_precision: DeepSeek's reference inference/model.py term for term where r6d rounded early: FP32 logits; the mHC stream projection in FP32, each FP32 weight split into three exact TF32 parts; the shared expert's SwiGLU in FP32 with one rounding; MoE partials rounded once per rank; WO-A's input through act_quant (E4M3, UE8M0 per 32) as the reference's 2026-10-12 revision does for both V4.1 Flash checkpoints, then the BF16 einsum (vLLM 0177, 0179), with WO-B's input cast exactly as the reference's act_quant
runtime_choices.greedy_verification: an all-greedy verification step whose logits nothing reads (no logprobs, penalties, logit bias, bad words, thinking budget, grammar, top-k/p, min-p) reduces each rank's vocabulary shard to a (max, index) pair and applies rejection_sample's greedy rule (vLLM 0112-0114, VLLM_GREEDY_VERIFICATION): the same committed tokens without the FP32 logits all-gather
runtime_choices.moe_shared_fold: the shared expert's output is added in the TileLang MoE combine with one rounding also when it runs on the aux stream (decode, up to 256 tokens): the combine waits for it (vLLM 0111, 0116)
runtime_choices.vocabulary_head_grid: token tiles vary fastest in the head kernel's grid, so a call past 64 rows reads each vocabulary block's packed weights once from DRAM (vLLM 0117)
runtime_choices.wo_projection: TileLang: the sparse MLA kernels store WO-A's input (vLLM 0179: the inverse RoPE, then the reference's act_quant quantize-dequantize, once per row in their output store); WO-A is a W8A16 GEMM on those BF16 values, split-K tiles by row bucket up to 128 rows and in-kernel tiles past that; its last kernel rounds to BF16 and applies the reference's per-token cast, so WO-B (the reference's MXFP8 linear) reads E4M3 and UE8M0 scales straight from it; sequence-parallel steps project through the rank-order exchange
runtime_choices.dspark_context_kv: TileLang block-32 projection with the reference's activation cast (vLLM 0131)
runtime_choices.sparse_mla_fold: every route (split, decode, extend) folds a segment as fma(l, b, L * a), so a prompt prefilled inside a sequence-parallel forward of other prompts rounds as it does alone (vLLM 0132; before, the extend route's one-segment fold was contracted by the compiler)
runtime_choices.startup_rendezvous: ranks meet before memory profiling on liveness, not a deadline: each rank's heartbeat (phase, kernels prepared) keeps the others waiting while it prepares (VLLM_STARTUP_RENDEZVOUS_TIMEOUT_MS is gone); profiling and warm-up name a stopped one-shot collective, as serving steps do (forum 384438#24)
runtime_choices.draft_budget: the draft-budget selection runs eagerly with its kernels loaded at startup (vLLM 0144); the JIT monitor reports torch.compile in serving
runtime_choices.nan_contracts: non-finite contracts for ten kernel families (vLLM 0134-0136, tests); the shared SwiGLU clamps (0137), the Engram gate floor (0138) and TileKernels' routed SwiGLU clamp (patches/tile_kernels 0001) keep a NaN, bit-identical on finite inputs
runtime_choices.engram_prefill: under prefill sequence parallelism each rank sends every other rank only that rank's real rows of its Engram wkv column block (vLLM 0150, 0152), and the TileLang gate reads the received blocks in place (engram_gate_blocked, bit-identical to the packed gate)
runtime_choices.checkpoint_copies: checkpoint tensors are copied to the GPU through anonymous memory, never pinned (vLLM 0147): a large host-to-device copy from untouched, unaligned file-mapped pages hangs on R580 with 64 KiB pages
runtime_choices.engram_debug_timeline: off (SPARK3_ENGRAM_TIMELINE, vLLM 0151; since r6s it records planning time too)
runtime_choices.sampling_defaults: DeepSeek's recommendation for V4.1 Flash 1017: temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0 for requests that set none (recipe generation_defaults, rendered as --override-generation-config); benchmarks and gates set their own
runtime_choices.chat_encoding: DeepSeek's 2026-10-16 encoding (vLLM 0178): a user message of only tool results continues the turn, so its reasoning is kept; tool-result images follow their calls' order; image placeholder tokens in text are refused
runtime_choices.model_mount: the Hugging Face hub cache mounted whole at /hub (1017's snapshot links into the hub's shared blob store), served from /hub/<snapshot>
runtime_choices.row_exchange: Engram's sequence-parallel row all-to-all (vLLM 0150) at four ranks sends the neighbours their blocks and each half of the opposite rank's block through one neighbour, forwarded in a second group (vLLM 0180): a switchless ring has no cable between ranks two apart. The triangle exchanges directly.

change_from_previous: r6u plus vLLM 0180: Engram's sequence-parallel row all-to-all relayed through the neighbours on the four-node ring, where r6u could not boot (NCCL's connection between ranks two apart timed out in memory profiling: r6s's all-to-all, released on the triangle only). Promoted for TP4 against r6n, the ring's last release; the triangle's path is r6u's (0180 changes only the four-rank exchange) and keeps r6u's release run as its reference. The ring schedules on its build's own DSpark cost curves. r6u's recipe and lock are frozen in experiments/2026-10-17-r6v/r6u as the rollback (r6n's TP4 recipe in experiments/2026-10-16-r6s/r6n).

evidence.summary: On the ring, on 1017 (release suite, one session, 2026-10-17 19:20-20:54 UTC, r6v / r6n on its production curves): prefill +3.8% at 32K, +4.2% at 128K, +3.8% at 256K, +3.7% at 512K, +3.2% at 1M, each beyond its interval; decode step geometric mean -0.05%, 16 and 8 streams +0.1% and 0.0%, Poisson 0.7 req/s level; acceptance length level (2.27); no greedy response identical to r6n's (WO-A's input quantization, DeepSeek's current reference), top-1 agreement 94.5%. Determinism gate on the ring: temperature 0 (3eab5112 / db25fde3) and greedy (c9cf9dbe) identical; 16, 8 and 4 distinct streams 243.4, 184.2 and 137.0 tok/s. Single stream (single-stream suite): 71.05 tok/s, TTFT p50 0.103 s. Release tests on the image: 1,371 passed, 41 skipped (the four-rank all-to-all test included). Owner, 2026-10-17: do TP4 with only the benching promotion and the release announcement need.
